name: Trustabl
description: Static reliability/safety scanner for AI agent repos (Claude, OpenAI, Google ADK, MCP). Gates the pipeline on risk + severity.
helpMarkDown: Runs the [trustabl](https://github.com/trustabl/trustabl) scanner over your repo, prints a readiness report, publishes JSON + SARIF artifacts, and can fail the build on a risk-score or severity threshold. See the extension README.
author: Trustabl

inputs.name: target
inputs.label: Scan target
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path or GitHub URL to scan. Defaults to the checked-out sources.

inputs.name: strict
inputs.label: Strict mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pass --strict (fail on any finding regardless of severity).

inputs.name: riskScoreThreshold
inputs.label: Risk-score threshold
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail when risk (100 - readiness) >= N (1-100). 0 = disabled.

inputs.name: severityThreshold
inputs.label: Severity threshold
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail when any finding's severity is >= this level.

inputs.name: publishArtifact
inputs.label: Publish scan results as a build artifact
inputs.helpMarkDown: Upload trustabl.json + trustabl.sarif as a pipeline artifact.

inputs.name: jsonFile
inputs.label: JSON output path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to write the full JSON ScanResult.

inputs.name: rulesRef
inputs.label: Rules ref
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pin a trustabl-rules git ref. Empty = trustabl default.

inputs.name: githubToken
inputs.label: GitHub token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional GitHub token (bearer) to avoid the anonymous GitHub API rate limit on version resolution + binary download. Pass a secret variable, e.g. $(GITHUB_TOKEN).

OutputVariables.name: readinessScore
OutputVariables.description: Readiness score, integer percent [0,100], higher = better.

OutputVariables.name: exitCode
OutputVariables.description: trustabl native exit code (0 clean / 1 findings / 2 error).
